name: Dr Owen Spear
title: Senior Clinical Psychologist & Board approved Supervisor
description: Senior Clinical Psychologist, couples therapist, and Board-Approved Supervisor. I use CBT, ACT, Internal family Systems, Schema Therapy, and EMDR among other approaches, and tailor my approach to the needs to each person I see.
specialties: schema therapy, EMDR, IFS, couples therapy, CBT, ACT

name: Savanti Amaratunga
title: Psychologist
description: I'm passionate about helping people navigate anxiety, depression, trauma, relationship difficulties, life transitions, and cultural identity concerns. I draw on evidence-based approaches like ACT, CBT, Schema Therapy, and mindfulness. Focus areas include childhood trauma/PTSD and sexual trauma/PTSD.
specialties: trauma, schema therapy, cultural identity, anxiety, depression

name: Joshua Santin
title: Psychologist
description: Whether you're navigating anxiety, depression, trauma, grief, ADHD, Autism, or interpersonal challenges, we'll work together to build insight, emotional resilience, and meaningful skills for growth. Focus areas include childhood, emotional, physical and sexual trauma/PTSD.

name: Renae Swann
title: Psychologist
description: I'm also a proud member of the LGBTQIA+ community and welcome clients from all walks of life. Drawing on Acceptance and Commitment Therapy, mindfulness, and narrative practices, I'll support you to navigate challenges such as trauma, grief, anxiety, ADHD, and emotional regulation. Focus areas include Gender/Sexual Identity/LGBTQIA+ and sexual trauma/PTSD.
specialties: LGBTQIA+, gender/sexual identity, trauma, PTSD, ACT, narrative therapy
identity: proud member of the LGBTQIA+ community

name: Julia Asanov
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: A Psychologist with a strong focus on trauma-informed, compassionate care. Drawing on CBT, ACT, mindfulness, and trauma-informed therapies such as Interpersonal Neurobiology, Internal Family Systems (IFS), and Sensorimotor techniques; supports anxiety, depression, trauma, grief and loss and perinatal mental health.
specialties: trauma, IFS, sensorimotor, perinatal mental health, anxiety, depression

name: Carmine Cristarella
title: Psychologist
description: Experience supporting clients with anxiety, depression, personality vulnerabilities (e.g., Borderline Personality Disorder), ADHD, autism, PTSD, and complex trauma. I draw from a range of evidence-based therapies – including CBT, Schema Therapy, EMDR, ACT, DBT, mindfulness, and trauma-informed approaches.
specialties: EMDR, schema therapy, complex trauma, PTSD, BPD, couples

name: Jemma Parnaby
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: I have a particular interest in supporting neurodivergent adults, as well as individuals experiencing trauma, anxiety, bipolar disorder, depression or difficulties related to identity and self-worth. When helpful, I draw from Schema Therapy, CBT, DBT, ACT and IFS-informed practice. Focus areas include Dissociative Identity Disorder and childhood trauma/PTSD.
specialties: dissociative identity disorder, schema therapy, trauma, neurodivergence, bipolar, IFS

name: Faith Thavaneswaran
title: Psychologist
description: I use a compassionate, evidence-based approach grounded in trauma-informed and neurodiversity-affirming practices, supporting anxiety, depression, trauma, emotion regulation and attachment challenges, with a dedicated focus on Autism/ADHD and chronic health conditions.
specialties: trauma, neurodiversity-affirming, autism, ADHD, IFS, somatic

name: Prue Lewis
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: A Clinical Psychologist with over 20 years of experience supporting adults through life's many challenges. Focus areas include Gender/Sexual Identity/LGBTQIA+.
specialties: LGBTQIA+, gender/sexual identity, ADHD, adult mental health
